Queried: 2026-09-05

Vendored scope:
- library/
- resources/
- the upstream build metadata and license files needed to reproduce the
  Nintendo Switch build

The upstream SDL and GLFW git submodules are intentionally not vendored.
The PlayWise Borealis PoC uses the Nintendo Switch deko3d backend, which does
not require either submodule. Updating this directory requires an explicit
commit change here plus a clean PoC build; it must never track a moving branch.

Local integration patch:
- `library/lib/platforms/switch/switch_platform.cpp` accepts
  `BOREALIS_SKIP_WIRELESS_PRIORITY`, used only by the offline PlayWise PoC so
  Eden does not stop on its unimplemented ISelfController command 80.
- `library/lib/platforms/switch/switch_video.cpp` uses `Z24S8` instead of a
  standalone `S8` stencil target because Eden/Ryujinx on Intel Iris Xe cannot
  expose `S8Uint`; NanoVG still receives an 8-bit stencil plane.
